senses.gloss:
Āhlāda
father of Naraharibhaṭṭa a. of C. Prakāśa on Vidagdhamukhamaṇḍana, Mithilā II. iii. 144.

Āhlādaka_Bhaṭṭa
Delarāmakathāsāra (adapted from perhaps a Persian story).
Pt.. K. M. 77, N. S. Press, Bombay, 1902.

Āhlādana
third son of Devacandra, younger brother of Ambaḍa Mantrin. At his instance Vardhamānasūri wrote his Vāsupūjyacaritra, in Saṁ. 1299 which bears consequently the ‘Āhlādana-aṅka’ (BBRAS. 1772, IO. 7664).

Āhlādalaharī
stotra. on Devī in 104 verses. by Jānī Mahāpātra, son of Jānī Jayadeva an. pupil of Paṇḍitarāya Jagannātha. Written in A. D. 1678.
Bik. 474. Bikaner 2976-8 (2976 inc.). Rep. Raj & C. I. p. 49. See J. G. Jha. Inst. IV. iii-iv. p.. 225-7.
